thread:
anya: quick heads-up — my PR for the Context Fallbacks doc tripped snippet CI. The example that shows switching to a condensed template after eviction is flaky across runs. PR: https://git.redwood/infr/docs/pull/521

marco: which snippet output mismatched?

anya: the JS and Python snippets that detect eviction vs 429. CI shows `429 Too Many Requests` in one run and `Stream closed` in another. Makes the retry guidance confusing.

samir: runtime note: under pressure we sometimes close streams instead of returning 429. Docs should normalize both cases: check status code || isStreamTruncated(err). Recommend preferring Retry-After header when available.

dev-rel: can we surface a tiny helper that returns {shouldRetry, retryAfter}? then reuse it in all language snippets. Keeps examples consistent.

marco: propose minimal helper in pseudo-code: `function normalizeErr(e){ return {shouldRetry: e.status==429 || e.code=='STREAM_TRUNC', retryAfter: parseInt(e.headers?.['retry-after']||'0') }}`

anya: yes. also need a short note about idempotency — don't auto-retry non-idempotent writes without an idempotency key.

docs-bot: snippet-lint: 2 mismatches across runs. CI details: https://ci.redwood/infr/snippets/521

ci-bot: holding snippet publish until micro-eval harness added and outputs stabilize.

dev-rel: i'll add the helper + tiny JS/Python/Go variants and a 3-case micro-eval (immediate 429, stream EOF, success). I'll also include expected console logs to make golden outputs stable.

samir: small runtime note for the docs: mention `x-rw-eviction: partial` (internal header) only as "the server may indicate eviction via headers" — avoid hard-coding the header name in examples.

anya: also found a broken anchor in the runbook link pointing to `#context-evictions`; should be `#context-fallbacks`. I'll add a link-fix in the PR.

marco: ping me for review once micro-eval is in. I'll fast-track merge if CI green.

docs-bot: reminder: include a micro-eval yaml with seeds and expected lines, keep it < 10 inputs so CI stays fast.

anya: thanks — i'll update the PR today and tag @marco @samir for final checks. :+1:
